comparison.objective: Slide an oven rack out, then remove a hot loaf pan without reaching into the oven.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe sequential rack actuation and pan extraction under a forbidden-region constraint.
comparison.success_condition: Pan removed only after rack extension and without arm entry into the oven; numeric rack/pan thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-constrained extraction and carrying rather than controlled fracture and recovery of millimetre-scale fragments. No spec versions were provided.
